title: Nvidia Will Be The World’s First $10 Trillion Company
excerpt: Nvidia already sits at the center of every major AI deal, data center, and startup shaping the future of technology. What happens when the company that suppl...

Douglas A. McIntyre

Wed, August 12, 2026 at 9:37 AM EDT 4 min read

Quick Read

  • Nvidia's $81 billion quarterly revenue, growing 85% year-over-year, puts it on pace to overtake Amazon atop the Fortune 500 within years.

  • NVDA's $500B data center partnership with Goldman Sachs (GS) channels debt financing back as Nvidia revenue, sustaining its 60%-plus quarterly growth.

  • At $5.4 trillion market cap, Nvidia needs to roughly double to hit $10 trillion, which is far less dramatic than its 977% five-year stock run.

  • It sounds nuts, but SoFi1 is giving new Active Invest users up to $3,000 in stock for a limited time, and all it takes is a $50 deposit to get started.2 See for yourself (Sponsor)

AI is the most important tech advance in human history, and perhaps the greatest investment of all time. One only has to talk to the hundreds of millions of people who use it (or perhaps billions) and the army of companies around the world that say it will transform the way their employees work and pave a golden road to profits. It has also made untold numbers of people richer via ownership of its stock and the constellation of AI-related companies that surround it. Many of these have been helped by investments from Nvidia (NASDAQ: NVDA), or loans that will make them grow faster. If AI is the world's most important technology development, Nvidia sits in the middle of its future.

After dozens of deals, it has financial relationships and ownership in Anthropic, OpenAI, Intel (NASDAQ: INTC), Coreweave, Nokia, Synopsys (NASDAQ: SNPS), Marvell (NASDAQ: MRVL) and at least half a dozen others.

SoFi Active Invest is offering a limited-time promotion. Open an account, fund it with $50 or more, and you could receive up to $3,000 in complimentary stock for Active Invest accounts. See for yourself by clicking here now. (Sponsor)

AI data centers are the heartbeat of AI's future. Nvidia has just pulled off a coup as it set up a partnership with some of the world's largest financial companies to set up a $500 billion facility to build out more of this infrastructure. The group includes Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Goldman Sachs (NYSE: GS) and several smaller companies. Goldman Sachs is the world's premier investment bank. BlackRock is the world's largest money manager. And Nvidia will backstop some of the deal, just in case other investors fall short. As Bloomberg reports, "Executives indicated that it will focus on debt financing to provide access to computers for Nvidia's largest customers and that there are already many deals in the works that would qualify toward this commitment." This means that much of this money will return to Nvidia as revenue, which is central to many of its other investments. "Round-tripping" of revenue or not, it helps to guarantee Nvidia's 60%-plus top-line quarterly growth.

人工智能是人类历史上最重要的技术进步，也许也是有史以来最大的投资。 人们只需与数亿（甚至数十亿）使用它的人以及世界各地的众多公司交谈，他们表示它将改变员工的工作方式并铺平一条通往利润的黄金之路。 它还通过拥有其股票和周围的人工智能相关公司群，让无数人变得更加富有。 其中许多都得到了英伟达（纳斯达克股票代码：NVDA）的投资或贷款的帮助，这些投资或贷款将使它们更快地增长。 如果人工智能是世界上最重要的技术发展，那么英伟达就处于其未来的中间位置。

经过数十笔交易，它在 Anthropic、OpenAI、英特尔（纳斯达克股票代码：INTC）、Coreweave、诺基亚、Synopsys（纳斯达克股票代码：SNPS）、Marvell（纳斯达克股票代码：MRVL）和至少六家其他公司建立了财务关系和所有权。

人工智能数据中心是人工智能未来的心跳。 英伟达刚刚取得了一次成功，它与一些全球最大的金融公司建立了合作伙伴关系，设立了一个价值 5000 亿美元的设施来建设更多的基础设施。 该集团包括阿波罗、贝莱德、黑石、高盛（纽约证券交易所股票代码：GS）和几家规模较小的公司。 高盛是全球首屈一指的投资银行。 贝莱德是全球最大的资金管理公司。 英伟达将支持部分交易，以防其他投资者达不到要求。 正如彭博社报道的那样，“高管们表示，公司将专注于债务融资，为英伟达最大的客户提供计算机服务，并且已经有许多正在进行中的交易符合这一承诺。” 这意味着大部分资金将作为收入返回英伟达，这对其许多其他投资至关重要。 无论收入是否“往返”，它都有助于保证 Nvidia 60% 以上的季度营收增长。
